text:
devin: quick thought  we should add a 'linger timer' slider to fallback controls (0-30s). idea: briefly keep trying primary before pivoting. tradeoffs?
maria: yes but make it clear it affects latency SLOs. separate toggles for latency-trigger vs error-rate-trigger.
sam: default 4s. add a small 'preview' button that simulates traffic in the console.
devin: propose three degrade behaviors: linger (keep trying), truncate (shorten response), pivot (immediate fallback). prefer simple names in UI.
olivia: call them: linger, truncate, pivot. good for runbooks.
ops-bot: feature-flag update: fallback_linger_rollout=10%
maria: telemetry fields: trigger_type, selected_behavior, ms_at_trigger, primary_tokens, fallback_tokens, sampled_trace_id. sampling per-org.
sam: audit: keep sampled original outputs 60-90d; UI must offer side-by-side diff and redact option. RBAC restrict raw output view.
devin: console UX: show a tiny pill "fell back: trigger=latency (5.1s)" with link to trace and a CTA "compare primary".
olivia: also include a one-click operator override: force-pivot for the org during incidents.
maria: API: emit header X-Rw-Fallback: behavior=linger;trigger=latency;trace=tr_42 when a fallback happens and offer fallback_meta in body if requested.
sam: curl sample: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate  # header: X-Rw-Fallback: behavior=truncate;trigger=error_rate;trace=tr_42
devin: sampling defaults? ops-bot suggests org-default 0.05% and experiment cohorts 2%.
ops-bot: applied: sampling_rate=0.05% / experiment_cohort=2%
maria: action items: telemetry schema PR, API header + body spec, console pill + compare flow, RBAC policy, experiment rollout plan, runbook copy.
sam: add unit + e2e tests for header emission and UI behavior.
devin: thanks. I'll drop a quick mock and link it here.
